messages:
maya: Found a reproducible hitch in the onboarding sample: rotate creds while a long Generator stream is active -> iterator silently stops and returns a bland error. Users think the run finished.
ben: What error string do you see?
maya: It shows "rpc error: code = Canceled desc = stream reset by peer". Not helpful for newcomers.
alex: If your sample recreates http.Client on refresh you will force TLS/TCP teardown. That makes the server close the bidi stream.
maya: Right, our demo did that for simplicity (we handed a fresh creds struct into client.New). Trying to keep snippets short backfired.
ben: Two practical fixes: 1) show a token-hot-swap RoundTripper in the sample that reads a token pointer atomically, 2) make the SDK return richer, typed iterator errors so callers can detect auth-driven disconnects.
alex: Quick RoundTripper sketch: 
```go
var token atomic.Value // stores string
rt := &AuthRT{Base: http.DefaultTransport, TokenGetter: func() string { return token.Load().(string) }}
client := &http.Client{Transport: rt}
// update token.Store(newToken) when refresh happens
```
No client recreation, no connection churn.
maya: Nice. For the SDK change I suggest we add ErrIteratorAuthRotate and ErrIteratorConnReset as exported errors so sample apps can show a retry banner instead of assuming completion.
ben: Agreed. Another idea: provide Generator.StreamReconnect(ctx, req, opts) helper that wraps retry logic for exactly this scenario (single transparent retry on auth rejection or a typed error otherwise). Docs would show when to prefer RoundTripper vs reconnect helper.
alex: Also add a tiny CI test that simulates token invalidation mid-stream and asserts the helper either retries or yields ErrIteratorAuthRotate depending on options.
devex-bot: created ticket DEVEX-991: onboarding sample: token-hot-swap + iterator error types (link) :spiral_notepad:
maya: I'll open a docs PR with the RoundTripper snippet and a short migration note: "If you must recreate clients, cancel streams explicitly and restart."
ben: I'll draft the error types and the reconnect helper API surface for review.
alex: If we ship both the doc and helper, new users will stop hitting this footgun. Good win for DX. :tada:
